name: ChirpStack
description: Open-source LoRaWAN network server for managing gateways, devices and application data end to end.

envVars.description: Hostname of an existing MQTT broker

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      POSTGRESQL_DSN: "postgres://chirpstack:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres/chirpstack?sslmode=disable"
      REDIS_SERVERS: "{{serviceName}}-redis:6379"
      MQTT_BROKER_HOST: {{env.MQTT_BROKER_HOST}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/etc/chirpstack
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: chirpstack
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: chirpstack
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
